script_text: Stop! Aquarius, the Uranus transit is striking your 8th House of Shared Resources, demanding radical transformation in how you approach money and partnership. Saturn forms a challenging square to your 10th House of Public Image, urging you to examine hidden financial patterns before they compound into larger problems. In love, you'll feel drawn to unconventional connections that challenge your usual comfort zone, but remain vigilant against emotional dependency that masks deeper insecurities. Your career path opens through bold innovation in leadership roles, particularly around transformative projects that require courage and originality. Avoid clinging to outdated financial structures that no longer serve you—this is your critical time for strategic reinvention. Instead, embrace unexpected opportunities that align with your visionary nature and unlock new professional possibilities. This is a blessing of sudden clarity about your true financial foundation. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
